reason: A Windows media utility for inspecting local video inputs and generating interpolated video or frame sequences through a GUI, CLI, and agent tools.

summaries.zh: 用于在 Windows 上检查本地视频或帧目录，并通过 RIFE 插帧生成 MP4 视频或 PNG 帧序列。
summaries.en: A Windows media tool that inspects local videos or frame directories and generates interpolated MP4 videos or PNG frame sequences with RIFE.

capabilities: Reads local video files and image-frame directories
Probes video resolution, frame rate, frame count, and audio presence
Interpolates video frames using bundled RIFE models
Writes interpolated MP4 files or PNG frame sequences
Provides GUI, headless CLI, and agent-facing tools
